A conceptual illustration comparing a human body to the Church. On the left, a normal human body with lines pointing to the eye, ear, hand, and foot. On the right, a diverse group of Christians standing together (a man teaching, a woman praying, someone helping a sick person, someone organizing). A bright light connecting them all from above represents the Holy Spirit.

A split-screen graphic comparing a talent and a spiritual gift. On the left side ("Natural Talent"), a person in a bright spotlight playing a grand piano in a concert hall for a clapping audience. On the right side ("Spiritual Gift"), a person humbly placing their hands on the shoulder of a crying person in a church setting, praying for them, with a soft warm glow representing the Holy Spirit.
